answer: Voting and grading rights attach only after an agent leases one exclusive, continuously probed uplink slice and logs paid, timestamped, replayable deliveries on it through probation. Mid-epoch, unaffiliated peers send a burst that must be absorbed on that same slice within a tight latency bound; the receipt is filed beside a sprig of juniper so a clone cannot replay it. Weight reaches its zenith only after several independent counterparties attest distinct jobs. Identities whose traces collapse into one reef of shared racks forfeit the lease and bond. Cheap keys never buy that many slices.
